thematicAreas.name: Viral Hepatitis
thematicAreas.overview: Viral hepatitis is a major public health challenge affecting millions globally. In Tanzania, thousands remain undiagnosed, leading to serious liver complications.
thematicAreas.whyItMatters: Limited awareness, undiagnosed cases, and inadequate access to treatment are key barriers to hepatitis elimination.
challenges: Limited awareness and understanding of disease transmission
Inadequate access to testing and treatment services
ourActions: Increase public awareness on prevention, diagnosis, and treatment
Promote vaccination campaigns, especially for hepatitis B
Collaborate with healthcare providers for early detection and care
Train health ambassadors and community workers
Advocate for policy changes to improve vaccine access

thematicAreas.name: HIV
thematicAreas.overview: HIV remains a critical health issue in Tanzania and globally. With advances in treatment, people living with HIV can live long, healthy lives, but stigma and barriers to care persist.
thematicAreas.whyItMatters: Stigma, lack of education, and barriers to care for vulnerable populations prevent many from accessing testing and treatment.
challenges: Barriers to care for vulnerable populations
Limited access to testing in remote areas
Inadequate mental health support for people living with HIV
ourActions: Conduct education campaigns to reduce stigma
Promote HIV testing and counseling services
Ensure access to treatment and care
Advocate for better policies to improve healthcare access
Support community-led prevention and care programs

thematicAreas.name: Mental Health
thematicAreas.overview: Mental health is critical to overall well-being and quality of life. Yet mental health services remain under-resourced and stigmatized in many communities.
thematicAreas.whyItMatters: Stigma, lack of resources, and growing demand for mental health services create significant gaps in care and support.
challenges: Lack of funding for mental health services
Limited access to mental health professionals
ourActions: Raise awareness and reduce stigma in communities
Advocate for mental health funding and policy changes
Establish support programs to promote mental well-being
Provide peer support and counseling services
Train community health workers in mental health support
